_instructions: Copy this file to athlete_profile.json in the project root and fill in your real data. athlete_profile.json is ignored by git (see .gitignore) — your personal data never gets pushed to the repository. The '_comment' and '_comment_*' fields are documentation only; you can delete them once you fill in the file, the code doesn't use them.

athlete._comment: Basic personal data and main season goal
athlete.name: {ATHLETE_NAME}

equipment._comment: Equipment relevant to aerodynamics and power analysis

bike_fit._comment: Bike biomechanical fitting. crank_length_mm.current and position_current are the data the aerodynamics tools (estimate_cda_from_position, calculate_speed_from_power) use as the current position reference.

position_delta._comment: Difference between position_current and position_previous. Fill in by hand or let the agent calculate it.

bike_fit._comment_fit_history: History of fitting changes with before/after metrics. Format of each entry (see add_fit_history_entry): {date, change, position_before, position_after, metrics_before, metrics_after, notes}.

physiology._comment: Physiological metrics. Can be filled in by hand or synced with intervals.icu (get_sport_settings) — the FTP used by analyze_session/compare_sessions is already resolved automatically from intervals.icu if not passed as a parameter.

biomechanics_notes._comment: Biomechanical analysis notes — filled in as the agent or the athlete generates them after position or fitting changes.

_comment_injury_history: List of injuries or issues. Format of each entry (see add_injury): {date, injury, body_part, recovery_weeks, status, notes}.
_comment_mobility_limitations: List of mobility restrictions relevant to fitting (e.g., hip stiffness, asymmetries). Free format.

training_context._comment_training_blocks: Planned training blocks. Free format (e.g., {name, start_date, end_date, focus}).

_comment_race_history: Race history: results, context, and lessons relevant to upcoming goals.
